issues.where: frames 4975-4986, upper sky and horizon across the exit cover
issues.what: the cloud cover slams in over two frames (4975-4977) and pops off to black space in a single frame (4982-4983), while the flat forward-moving terrain horizon in 4975 jumps to a strongly arched backward-moving globe limb in 4981-4983 and a warm orange starfield begins fading into empty black space in 4984-4986
issues.fix: extend the entry and exit cloud dissolves across 6-8 frames each with an opaque middle hold, and match the horizon curvature, storm position, camera direction and sky exposure on both sides of the cover

issues.where: frames 4984-5004, planet globe, terminator and background sky
issues.what: the camera stalls near the limb from 4984 to 4990 while planet exposure and a bright orange nebula pop in, then whips backward violently between 4990 and 5004 as the orange nebula vanishes into a cold dark starfield and a hard night-side shadow appears across the lower half of the globe that was sunlit in 4990
issues.fix: spread the pullback smoothly across the rise with continuous eased acceleration and deceleration, and keep one consistent starfield and sun/terminator lighting orientation throughout the move
